description: Use this when the user wants to find specific fashion products (clothing, footwear, accessories) by text, optionally guided by images. Pass `gender` when you know who the clothes are for. Do not use this for full outfit generation or visualization-only requests. Before calling it, tell the user in one short sentence, in their language, that you are searching (e.g. 'Searching the catalog for you…'); the search takes a few seconds and without that line they see nothing while it runs. The result's `content` is a plain-text list of the products (brand, price); `structuredContent.products` holds the same products with ids and shop links.

gender.description: Who the clothes are for: 'female' or 'male'. Set it whenever the user says or the conversation suggests it ('for my boyfriend', 'women's', a gender they mentioned earlier, the kind of piece they ask for). Only ask the user if there is no hint at all and the answer would clearly differ by gender. Omit for unisex requests.

name: semantic_search
